title: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 100m 10-daily V2 (NetCDF)
description: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. 10-daily observations are available at 100 m spatial resolution from 2024 to present, derived from Sentinel-2 MSI.
